correctness.rationale: All quantifiers q>=3,h>=1, any nonempty two-sided binary Y were checked. The lift-factor bijection holds in both time directions. Under reversal the difference vector becomes minus the reversed vector, so only 0^m survives for q>=3. Fixed points of the induced residue-class involution number f_h(n) and yield exactly q^((h+f)/2) palindrome factors. Orbit counting establishes the formula; bounds and h=1,2 cases were verified. The standalone finite checks passed 48 parameter triples, but the proof does not depend on them.

value.rationale: The transfer identity is uniform over every binary base subshift and all q>=3 and h>=1, yet the entire reflection deficit depends solely on a single all-zero factor. The noble-means specialization supplies a natural, already-proved strictly ergodic family with a sharp, calculable reversal-pair window and eventual equality r=rho. This complete structural invariant and phase distinction from q=2 extend beyond a routine numerical count or arbitrary parameter substitution.
